def min_key_presses(n, a, r1, c1, r2, c2):
    # Calculate vertical movement
    vertical_moves = abs(r1 - r2)
    
    # Calculate horizontal movement
    if r1 == r2:
        horizontal_moves = abs(c1 - c2)
    else:
        # Move to the end of the current line if necessary
        if c1 != a[r1 - 1] + 1:
            horizontal_moves = (a[r1 - 1] + 1 - c1) + c2 - 1
        else:
            horizontal_moves = c2 - 1
    
    # Total moves is the sum of vertical and horizontal moves
    total_moves = vertical_moves + horizontal_moves
    
    return total_moves
